class.name: RosActionClient
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Action Client for sending goals to an action server.

method.name: create_goal
method.description: Creates and returns an empty [RosMsg] of the correct type for this client's action goals (e.g. the [code]Goal[/code] part of the action definition).

method.name: is_server_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an action server for this action is currently available. Unlike [method wait_for_server] this never blocks.

method.name: send_goal
method.description: Sends a [param goal] to the action server asynchronously. Returns a [RosGoalHandle] that tracks the goal's lifecycle: acceptance/rejection, feedback and the final result.

method.name: wait_for_server
method.description: Blocks until the action server is available or [param timeout_sec] is reached. Returns [code]true[/code] if the server is available.

method.name: wait_for_server_async
method.description: Asynchronously waits for the action server to become available up to [param timeout_sec] seconds. Emits the [signal server_available] signal when the server state changes or the timeout is reached.

signal.name: server_available
signal.description: Emitted when the action server becomes available or when an asynchronous wait times out.
